title: Equipment Handoff Checklist
subtitle: Equipment Handoff: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Equipment Handoff Checklist covers equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation. The equipment custody coordinator records Equipment Handoff criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Equipment Handoff Checklist keeps Equipment Handoff exceptions visible until the equipment custody coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Equipment Handoff Checklist at issuing location, receiving location, transport path, and return point. Document equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation identity before Equipment Handoff begins. Compare equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation findings with stated Equipment Handoff criteria; route unresolved Equipment Handoff issues to asset-control reviewer. For Equipment Handoff Checklist, confirm requirements for Equipment Handoff. Ask asset-control reviewer to review Equipment Handoff conditions beyond the equipment custody coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspection scope and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Equipment Handoff, identify responsible parties, issuing location, receiving location, transport path, and return point, and the linked equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation source.

fields.label: Asset tag, serial, model, and quantity
Accessory, key, credential, software, and configuration identifiers

sections.title: Checklist points, conditions, and actions
sections.guidance: Capture Equipment Handoff facts for equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Equipment Handoff inspection checks
items: Custody date, location, and intended use
Return condition, due date, and unresolved defect

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

sections.title: Inspection disposition and reviewer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: List each unresolved Equipment Handoff finding with its restriction, correction owner, and reinspection trigger. Equipment Custody Coordinator records reviewer disposition.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Unsafe or failed equipment cannot be released
blocks.guidance: Pause Equipment Handoff when authority, identity, condition, data protection, accessory accounting, or custody remains unresolved. Retain the available Equipment Handoff proof and route unresolved equipment unit, accessory set, condition, configuration, custody, and return obligation scope to equipment custody coordinator.
